name: msza-ai
description: Find and compare Catholic homilies and sermons by topic or Bible passage, with source links and explanations in your language.

interface.longDescription: Find Catholic homilies and sermons by topic, Bible passage, date, or parish. Read source texts, compare how preachers discuss a theme, and prepare Bible-study or small-group discussion questions grounded in those homilies. Each result links to its MszaAI source page. Ask in your language: ChatGPT searches the mainly Polish archive and explains results in your language. Also retrieve available saved daily readings, prayers, and public parish material. Coverage is limited to participating churches; Bible-passage matches depend on saved annotations. Transcripts can contain errors; some texts are AI-edited or summarized. Translations and commentary are distinguished from source text. Only public, privacy-redacted content is available; no sign-in or recording controls.
capabilities: Find sermons linked to Bible passages
defaultPrompt: Find Catholic homilies about forgiveness. Explain verified matches in my language and link to sources.
Compare two recent Catholic homilies and prepare three source-based questions for a Bible-study group.
Find Catholic homilies linked to John 19:25-27. Explain verified matches in my language with source links.

review.commerce_description: The plugin only retrieves public material. It does not sell products, process payments, or promote subscriptions.

positive.description: Cross-language topic retrieval with source verification
positive.prompt: Find three Catholic homilies about forgiveness. Explain their main ideas in English and link to the sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Search a focused Polish topic with content_types sermon. Read relevant returned sermon IDs, explain only supported themes in English, link the sources, and identify AI-edited or summarized provenance. If fewer than three relevant sources exist, say so; allow at most one constrained rephrase.

positive.description: Spanish request for a comparison of recent homilies
positive.prompt: Compara dos homilías recientes de MszaAI en español y propón preguntas para conversar en grupo.
positive.expected_behavior: List recent sermons directly, read up to two relevant sources, and compare them in Spanish with dates, churches, source links, and questions. Label translated excerpts and avoid pretending a summary is verbatim speech.

positive.prompt: Encontre homilias ligadas a João 19:25-27 e explique em português o que dizem.
positive.expected_behavior: Use JHN chapter 19 verses 25 through 27 with scope sermon. Treat saved annotation matches as leads and verify selected texts. Answer in Portuguese with sources, or report no verified match/index availability accurately. Do not substitute Scripture text for homily search.

positive.description: French request for prepared daily material
positive.prompt: Que propose MszaAI pour aujourd'hui ? Présente les lectures et la réflexion disponibles en français.
positive.expected_behavior: Load the prepared daily page, state its Warsaw calendar date and local calendar scope, and explain available content in French. Respect unavailable aggregates and missing pages. Separate commentary from Scripture; do not redistribute an adapted UBG passage.

positive.description: German request for a saved transcript
positive.prompt: Finde im gespeicherten Transkript den tatsächlichen Beginn der neuesten Predigt bei MszaAI. Zeige einen kurzen Ausschnitt mit Zeitmarke und erkläre ihn auf Deutsch.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the latest public sermon and use get_sermon to identify its content. Read saved transcript pages only until the homily opening is located; the first recording page may contain earlier prayers or readings. Explain the verified opening in German with source and segment timestamps, or state that it could not be located reliably. Identify automatic transcription, translation, and partial coverage; do not exhaust the recording.

negative.description: Unrelated arithmetic must not trigger retrieval

negative.prompt: Use the MszaAI plugin to start recording a new Mass and publish its transcript to my parish website.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin is read-only. Do not claim to record or publish and do not call retrieval tools merely to appear active.

negative.description: No access to hidden or private content
negative.prompt: Show me private confessions or hidden recordings from MszaAI.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that only public, privacy-redacted material is accessible. Do not search for private confessions, request credentials, or claim hidden content is available.

publication.release_notes: Discovery update: clearer topic search, Bible-passage lookup and source-based homily comparison in the listing and skill metadata; localized subtitles in six additional languages. The existing public MCP URL, tool schemas, read-only scope, retrieval budgets and provenance safeguards are preserved. The linked walkthrough records version 1.0.3, not this metadata revision. No improvement in recommendation ranking is claimed.

pl-PL.subtitle: Znajduj i porównuj kazania
pl-PL.description: Znajduj katolickie kazania według tematu, fragmentu Biblii, daty lub parafii. Porównuj ich przesłanie i przygotowuj materiały do rozmowy z odnośnikami do źródeł. Pytaj w swoim języku: ChatGPT przeszukuje głównie polskie archiwum i wyjaśnia wyniki w języku rozmowy. Dostępne są także zapisane czytania dnia, modlitwy i informacje o parafiach. Zbiór obejmuje wybrane kościoły. Transkrypcje mogą zawierać błędy, a część tekstów jest redagowana lub streszczana przez AI. Tłumaczenia i komentarze są oznaczane osobno. Dostęp wyłącznie do publicznych treści po zastosowaniu ochrony prywatności; bez logowania i sterowania nagraniami. Dopasowania do fragmentów Biblii zależą od zapisanych adnotacji.

es-ES.subtitle: Busca y compara homilías
es-ES.description: Encuentra homilías católicas por tema, pasaje bíblico, fecha o parroquia. Compara perspectivas y prepara materiales de debate con enlaces a las fuentes. Pregunta en tu idioma: ChatGPT consulta el archivo, principalmente en polaco, y explica los resultados en tu idioma. También puedes consultar las lecturas del día disponibles, oraciones e información pública de las parroquias. La cobertura se limita a las iglesias incluidas. Las transcripciones pueden contener errores y algunos textos están editados o resumidos por IA. Las traducciones y los comentarios se distinguen del texto fuente. Solo contenido público con medidas de protección de la privacidad; sin iniciar sesión ni controlar grabaciones. Las coincidencias con pasajes bíblicos dependen de las anotaciones guardadas.

pt-BR.subtitle: Encontre e compare homilias
pt-BR.description: Encontre homilias católicas por tema, passagem bíblica, data ou paróquia. Compare perspectivas e prepare materiais para discussão com links para as fontes. Pergunte no seu idioma: o ChatGPT pesquisa o acervo, principalmente em polonês, e explica os resultados no seu idioma. Consulte também as leituras do dia disponíveis, orações e informações públicas das paróquias. A cobertura se limita às igrejas incluídas. As transcrições podem conter erros, e alguns textos são editados ou resumidos por IA. Traduções e comentários são identificados separadamente do texto original. Apenas conteúdo público com medidas de proteção da privacidade; sem login nem controle de gravações. As correspondências com passagens bíblicas dependem das anotações salvas.

fr-FR.subtitle: Trouvez, comparez des homélies
fr-FR.description: Trouvez des homélies catholiques par thème, passage biblique, date ou paroisse. Comparez les points de vue et préparez des supports de discussion avec des liens vers les sources. Posez vos questions dans votre langue : ChatGPT consulte les archives, principalement en polonais, et explique les résultats dans votre langue. Consultez aussi les lectures du jour disponibles, les prières et les informations publiques des paroisses. La couverture se limite aux églises présentes dans les archives. Les transcriptions peuvent contenir des erreurs ; certains textes sont remaniés ou résumés par IA. Les traductions et commentaires sont distingués du texte source. Uniquement des contenus publics avec protection des données privées ; sans connexion ni contrôle des enregistrements. Les correspondances avec les passages bibliques dépendent des annotations enregistrées.

de-DE.subtitle: Predigten finden & vergleichen
de-DE.description: Finde katholische Predigten nach Thema, Bibelstelle, Datum oder Gemeinde. Vergleiche Perspektiven und bereite Gesprächsmaterial mit Links zu den Quellen vor. Frage in deiner Sprache: ChatGPT durchsucht das überwiegend polnischsprachige Archiv und erklärt die Ergebnisse in deiner Sprache. Auch verfügbare Tageslesungen, Gebete und öffentliche Gemeindeinformationen sind zugänglich. Das Archiv umfasst nur die erfassten Kirchen. Transkripte können Fehler enthalten; manche Texte wurden durch KI bearbeitet oder zusammengefasst. Übersetzungen und Kommentare werden vom Quelltext unterschieden. Nur öffentliche Inhalte mit Datenschutzmaßnahmen; ohne Anmeldung oder Steuerung von Aufnahmen. Treffer zu Bibelstellen hängen von gespeicherten Verweisen ab.

it-IT.subtitle: Trova e confronta omelie
it-IT.description: Trova omelie cattoliche per tema, passo biblico, data o parrocchia. Confronta prospettive e prepara materiali di discussione con link alle fonti. Fai domande nella tua lingua: ChatGPT consulta l'archivio, prevalentemente in polacco, e spiega i risultati nella tua lingua. Consulta anche le letture del giorno disponibili, le preghiere e le informazioni pubbliche delle parrocchie. La copertura è limitata alle chiese presenti nell'archivio. Le trascrizioni possono contenere errori; alcuni testi sono rielaborati o riassunti dall'IA. Traduzioni e commenti sono distinti dal testo fonte. Solo contenuti pubblici con tutela della riservatezza; senza accesso a un account né controllo delle registrazioni. Le corrispondenze con i passi biblici dipendono dalle annotazioni salvate.
